description: This file defines abstract base classes for various user interface components related to exception handling, message display, and window management in a graphical application. It includes class definitions for interface, main exception window, exit window, message window, and save exception window, with method signatures and documentation but no concrete implementations.

classes.name: AbstractIntf
classes.description: Base class for interface implementations, providing methods for creating and managing various windows and dialogs, such as network enablement, exit, message, and exception handling.

classes.name: AbstractMainExceptionWindow
classes.description: Abstract class for the main exception dialog, handling traceback display and dialog lifecycle.

classes.name: AbstractExitWindow
classes.description: Abstract class for a basic exit message dialog, with methods for creating, destroying, and running the dialog.

classes.name: AbstractMessageWindow
classes.description: Abstract class for a generic message dialog, with methods for creating, destroying, and running the dialog.

classes.name: AbstractSaveExceptionWindow
classes.description: Abstract class for a dialog that offers options to save exception tracebacks, with methods for creating and running the dialog.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructors for each class, initializing dialog or widget attributes, often with documentation on expected behavior.

methods.name: enableNetwork
methods.description: Method to display a dialog to enable network, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: exitWindow
methods.description: Method to display a quit dialog with title and message, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: mainExceptionWindow
methods.description: Method to create and return an initial exception handling dialog, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: messageWindow
methods.description: Method to display a generic informational message, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: saveExceptionWindow
methods.description: Method to create and return an exception saving dialog, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Method to destroy the dialog, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Method to run the dialog and set a return value, must be implemented by subclasses.
